title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

suppliers.sup:70110: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal on your price adjustment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for many years of reliable partnership, which we value as much as you do. Our should-cost estimate for part:310010 is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010), below your price. The forecast for part:310010 increased by 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price. PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

Our current contract (ctr:4600070110) runs until 31 December 2026. You asked in September for faster payment, so one attached package offers payment within 14 days to support your cash flow. Which of the three attached packages suits you best?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal on your price adjustment
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

In recognition of your verified figures, we have adjusted our calculation and propose a revised price of €132.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. We are pleased to build on your first package offering 14-day payment terms, as this aligns with our previous request. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? The offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for reviewing our figures so carefully and for building on our first package. We value the partnership you described during your visits.

Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).

We have kept your preferred structure as our lead package: payment within 14 days, which supports your cash flow as you asked in September, effective 1 November 2026. Two alternatives with a later effective date and 30-day payment are also attached, in case they suit your planning better. All packages cover 8,150 pieces per year over 12 months.

Which package can you sign? If a later start or different payment timing helps you, please let us know.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised packages
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. In recognition of your verified figures, we propose a revised price of €130.20 per unit. We are pleased to continue building on your first package with 14-day payment terms, as this supports our operations. 

For our family foundry, maintaining our long-standing partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH remains deeply important. Therefore, our current offer is a price of €130.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This proposal remains valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our family foundry has always valued the long-standing partnership between our companies, and we appreciate the shared history we have built together in our region. 

We have already taken that quality record data into account. As this kind of fact was already taken into account in our previous adjustments, we must hold our current offer of €130.20 per unit. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

For complete clarity, our offer rests on a price of €130.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

We value our long-standing partnership and look forward to your confirmation of this package. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the 8D report with its 900 ppm commitment. We welcome the containment and corrective actions you describe.

We have moved our price a further step towards yours. The attached package keeps the structure you prefer: payment within 14 days, which supports your cash flow as you asked in September, effective 1 November 2026. It covers 8,150 pieces per year over 12 months, which continues our long partnership beyond the current contract ctr:4600070110.

We would be glad to sign on this basis. Could you confirm the attached package, or tell us which change to the start date or payment timing would let you meet it?

Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings - revised package for signature
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We truly value our long-standing relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and appreciate your further step. However, after careful consideration, we cannot reduce our price further for this package. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We must hold our offer of €130.10 per unit for payment within 14 days starting 1 November 2026. For your planning, our offer remains valid for 7 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. You asked about changes to the start date or payment timing; please propose a specific package if you wish to explore those options. 

Our family foundry takes great pride in the quality and craftsmanship we deliver to our partners in the region, and we hope we can continue our work together on these terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
